design_summary.current_reward: Per-step r_t = -(increment of the cumulative source-inclusive team delay J) per 1 s tick, computed in accel_plant.episode (before/after one cf.tick around b.totals['team_delay_vs']) in vehicle-seconds per second; one global scalar per step shared by every CAV; no shaping, no per-CAV decomposition; GAE in accel_learner.advantages (UNIT=1e4, GAMMA=exp(-1/600), LAMBDA=exp(-1/1200)); identical entry for A (accel_learner.update) and B/R (exact_grade._ppo_exact_update).
design_summary.critic_centralized: Yes: one joint observable-state critic (tools/coopnative/policy.Policy) - single MLP over the pooled observable frame (all sensed vehicles, CAV and HDV, whitelist rows) plus RSU per-lane aggregates; one scalar value per control step shared across the step's CAVs; V2V widens the input with partner blocks, value stays one scalar (CTDE over observable state, no hidden/global truth).
design_summary.formula: r'_t = r_t + w * mean_{i in CAVs} mean_{j in N_i(t)} outcome_j (the per-CAV r_i' = r_i + w*mean_{j in N_i} r_j collapses onto the shared scalar reward of the joint policy/critic); outcome_j = max(0, 1 - v_j/SPEED_LIMIT_MPS) vehicle-seconds from the POST-step observable frame row of neighbour j (charged second's final step falls back to its own frame; counted in the report).
design_summary.neighbourhood: N_i = ONLY the observable receipt-frame rows (CAV and HDV alike, no driver-type oracle) within the SAME 100 m range the CAV already senses via V2V (v2v_obs.V2V_RANGE_M == wms.control.contract.SENSOR_RANGE_M == 100.0, radio range, no lane filter); background-traffic term NOT added (no per-vehicle background decomposition exists in the receipts and r_t already carries the whole-world team outcome - double-count otherwise; background_rule recorded in the per-update report).
design_summary.where_applied: warm_runner.run_arm once per arm-update: coop_reward.training_episodes returns NEW episode dicts (per-step shallow copies, receipts untouched) passed ONLY to the PPO/imitation update call; every other consumer (viability/evidence critic diagnostics, health/safety, practice, bank grading) keeps the raw team-J rewards.
design_summary.logging: {arm}_UPDATE_{u:03}.json gains a coop_reward block only when ON: weight/provenance/arms, own_reward_sum/mean_veh_s vs team_addition_sum/mean_veh_s and team_neighbourhood_mean_veh_s, egos/steps/empty_neighbourhood_egos/own_frame_team_steps, pinned range+speed limit.
design_summary.off_identity: OFF (or arm not enabled): training_episodes returns the SAME episode list object and None report; prepare_intent writes NO coop keys; producer output, PPO inputs, GAE and receipts are byte-identical to the branch point (test: same-object assertion + no receipt key).
